response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_rate_per_day FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS overall_mean FROM per_rating) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_rate_per_day, p.avg_rate_per_day - o.overall_mean AS amount_above_mean FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_rate_per_day > o.overall_mean

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff means replacement_cost strictly greater than 20.99.
